description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from the client for this parameter. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters long.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier register-service --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id service-f7024a22ea5149xxxxxx --client-token 10CM943JP0EN9D51H --region cn-hangzhou
